tags.name: Setup
tags.description: First-run claim of a fresh server using the one-time setup token written to `<data>/setup-token.txt` on first start.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Login (cookie or bearer-token mode), logout, session info, self-registration, email verification and password reset.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The signed-in user: profile, password, TOTP two-factor authentication, sessions and personal access tokens (PATs).

get.description:
Tells clients whether the server still needs its first administrator, plus public server facts used by login screens and apps (server name, registration flag, version, TLS fingerprint for trust-on-first-use).

**Scope:** `public`

post.description:
Claims a fresh server. Requires the one-time **setup token** that the server generated on first start
(written to `<data>/setup-token.txt`, mode 0600 — e.g. `sudo cat /var/lib/ludworks/setup-token.txt`; the log only names the file).
Creates the admin account, logs it in with a session cookie and invalidates the token.
Rate limited per IP. Until setup is complete every other API route answers `503 setup_required`.

**Scope:** `public`

409.description: The server is already set up.

post.description:
Authenticates with username (or email) and password.

* Default: sets the `lw_session` cookie and returns the `csrf_token` for subsequent unsafe requests.
* `token_mode: true`: no cookie; returns a bearer session token `lws_…` in `token` (for the SDK, apps and browser extension).
* If the account has TOTP enabled and no code was sent, the response is `401 totp_required` (the password was correct) —
  resend with `totp_code` or a `recovery_code`.

Brute-force protection: per-IP and per-account rate limiting with exponential lockout (429 + `Retry-After`).
Unknown usernames cost the same time as real ones.

**Scope:** `public`

200.description: Logged in. With cookie mode the response also carries `Set-Cookie`.

401.description: `invalid_credentials` (wrong username/password/code) or `totp_required` (password correct, second factor needed).

post.description:
Revokes the current session or bearer token. For a browser (cookie) session it also clears the cookie and sends `Clear-Site-Data: "cache"`, so private files and thumbnails the browser cached are dropped. To revoke a PAT use `DELETE /api/v1/me/tokens/{id}`.

**Scope:** `auth`

get.description:
Returns the signed-in user, the CSRF token of the cookie session (web UI bootstrap after reload), the session expiry and effective scopes.

**Scope:** `auth`

post.description:
Creates a regular account when `general.registration_enabled` is on (otherwise `403 registration_disabled`).
If `general.require_email_verification` is on, a verification email is sent and the user is not logged in until verified;
otherwise the user is logged in with a session cookie (fetch the CSRF token with `GET /api/v1/auth/session`). Rate limited per IP.
With verification on, an email address that already has an account is answered exactly like a fresh registration (201, `verification_required: true`) without creating an account; the address owner is emailed instead, so the endpoint does not reveal registered addresses. Usernames are unique and a taken one is reported (409); without verification a taken address is reported too (409), because the new account would be signed in at once.

**Scope:** `public`

409.description: Username already in use; or, when email verification is off, email address already in use.

post.description:
Consumes the token from a verification email or from an email-change confirmation (see `PATCH /api/v1/me`). The latter switches the account to the confirmed address and marks it verified, or answers `410 gone` if another account took the address meanwhile. Tokens are single-use and expire.

**Scope:** `public`

Always answers `202` whether or not the address exists (no account enumeration). Requires SMTP to be configured; the email contains a single-use, short-lived link.

**Scope:** `public`

202.description: Accepted (an email is sent if the address belongs to an active account).

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset token
post.description:
Sets the new password and **revokes all sessions and session tokens** of the account.

**Scope:** `public`

patch.description:
Updates display name, email or the mail-in opt-in. When SMTP is configured, a new email address is not applied at once: the response is the unchanged user with `email_change_pending: true`, the current address is notified, and the new address receives a confirmation link (redeemed with `POST /api/v1/auth/verify-email`) unless another account already uses it. The answer is identical either way, so this endpoint does not reveal registered addresses. Without SMTP the change applies at once and resets `email_verified` (409 if the address is taken). Email changes are rate limited per user (429).

**Scope:** `account`

200.description: Updated user. `email_change_pending` is present (true) when a new email address awaits confirmation.

email_change_pending.description: A confirmation link was sent to the requested address (if no other account uses it); `email` changes once it is redeemed.

409.description: Email already in use (only when SMTP is not configured and the change applies at once).

post.description:
Requires the current password. Revokes every **other** session and session token (the current one stays valid). Rate limited.

**Scope:** `account`

401.description: `invalid_credentials` when `current_password` is wrong (or `unauthorized` without a session).

post.description:
Generates a new secret (stored encrypted, pending) and returns it with an `otpauth://` URI for the authenticator app. Confirm with `POST /api/v1/me/totp/enable`.

**Scope:** `account`

Verifies a code from the authenticator app against the pending secret, enables 2FA and returns 10 single-use recovery codes (shown once, stored hashed). Rate limited.

**Scope:** `account`

409.description: No pending setup, or TOTP already enabled.

post.description:
Requires the account password and a current TOTP code. Deletes the secret and all recovery codes. Rate limited.

**Scope:** `account`

401.description: `invalid_credentials` when the password or code is wrong.

get.description:
Active browser sessions, `lws_` session tokens and personal access tokens of the caller.

**Scope:** `account`

delete.description:
Revoking the browser session the request itself uses signs this browser out: the cookie is cleared and `Clear-Site-Data: "cache"` is sent.

**Scope:** `account`

post.description:
Creates an `lwp_` token limited to `scopes`. The token value is returned **once**; only its SHA-256 is stored.

**Scope:** `account`

setup_required.description: `true` until the first admin account has been created.

tls_fingerprint_sha256.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the server TLS certificate (for TOFU pinning by apps); `null` when TLS is off.

setup_token.description: One-time token from `<data>/setup-token.txt` (the server log names the file; the token itself is logged only if that file could not be written).

password.description: Password: at least `security.password_min_length` characters (default 12), at most 1024 bytes.

csrf_token.description: CSRF token for the new cookie session.

recovery_code.description: One of the 10 single-use recovery codes (instead of `totp_code`).

token_mode.description: When `true` no cookie is set and a bearer session token (`lws_…`) is returned in `token` (SDK, apps, extensions).

device_name.description: Label shown in the session list, e.g. "Pixel 9 — Ludworks TV".

csrf_token.description: CSRF token for cookie sessions (send as `X-CSRF-Token`).

expires_at.description: Absolute expiry of the session (it may also end earlier after `security.session_idle_minutes` of inactivity).

token.description: Bearer session token `lws_…` — only present when `token_mode` was `true`. Store it in secure OS storage.

csrf_token.description: CSRF token of the current cookie session.

password.description: Password: at least `security.password_min_length` characters (default 12), at most 1024 bytes.

verification_required.description: When `true` a verification email was sent and the user is **not** logged in yet.

token.description: Token from the emailed reset link.

new_password.description: Password: at least `security.password_min_length` characters (default 12), at most 1024 bytes.

email.description: New email; it becomes unverified when verification is required.

mail_in_enabled.description: Turn emails sent from your verified address to the server mailbox into notes.

new_password.description: Password: at least `security.password_min_length` characters (default 12), at most 1024 bytes.

otpauth_url.description: `otpauth://totp/…` URI for authenticator apps / QR codes.

recovery_codes.description: Ten single-use recovery codes. Shown once — store them safely.

kind.description: `session` = cookie or `lws_` login; `token` = personal access token.

device_name.description: Device label given at login (may be empty).

current.description: Whether this is the session making the request.

prefix.description: First characters of the token for recognition, e.g. `lwp_ab12`.

scopes.description: Requested scopes. Must be a subset of the caller's scopes; `admin` requires the admin role.

expires_in_days.description: Lifetime in days; omit for a non-expiring token.
